title.zh: 同一组 logits，为什么会生成不同答案？
title.en: Why Can the Same Logits Produce Different Answers?

dek.zh: 拆开 temperature、greedy、top-k、top-p、seed 与 constrained decoding，建立 Agent 多样性、正确性和系统级确定性的工程边界。
dek.en: Unpack temperature, greedy decoding, top-k, top-p, seeds, and constrained decoding to define the engineering boundary between agent diversity, correctness, and system-level determinism.

html.zh:
Transformer 的最后一层输出 vocabulary logits。logits 不是答案，也不是概率；它们是每个候选 token 的未归一化分数。runtime 还要执行一条 decoding policy：应用 repetition/grammar 等约束、用 temperature 重标分数、截断候选集合、softmax 归一化，然后选择或随机采样一个 token。每生成一步，这条 policy 都重新运行。

因此“模型相同”不等于“行为相同”。同一 checkpoint、同一 prompt 在不同 decoding 参数下，可以从稳定的工具名变成有创造力的解释，也可以陷入重复或抽到低概率错误。反过来，temperature 设为 0 或 greedy decoding 只让token selection policy趋于确定；并不能固定模型版本、浮点 kernel、并发调度、tool state、网络结果或 Agent runtime 的分支。

核心判断：sampling 控制如何从模型已经给出的分布中选路径，不会把错误 logits 变正确。constrained decoding 能保证输出属于某个语法语言，却仍不能保证参数语义、权限或环境事实。
html.en:
The final Transformer layer emits vocabulary logits. Logits are neither an answer nor probabilities; they are unnormalized scores for candidate tokens. The runtime still executes a decoding policy: apply repetition or grammar constraints, rescale scores with temperature, truncate the candidate set, normalize with softmax, and then select or randomly sample one token. The policy runs again at every generation step.

Consequently, “the same model” does not imply the same behavior. The same checkpoint and prompt can produce a stable tool name under one decoding configuration, a diverse explanation under another, or a repetitive or low-probability error under a poor one. Conversely, temperature zero or greedy decoding makes the token-selection policy approach determinism; it does not freeze model revisions, floating-point kernels, concurrent scheduling, tool state, network results, or branches in the agent runtime.

Core judgment: sampling controls which path is selected from the distribution the model already produced. It cannot make incorrect logits correct. Constrained decoding can guarantee membership in a syntactic language, but it cannot guarantee parameter semantics, authorization, or environmental truth.

title.en: Connect training to the agent loop

html.zh:
1/4 解释了 cross-entropy 如何训练 pθ(next token | prefix)；2/4 解释了 optimizer、数据与 compute 怎样塑造参数 θ。今天固定 θ，研究 inference policy。模型输出 logits 后，training objective 已经结束；temperature 和 top-p 不会临时改参数，只改变下一 token 的选择分布。

在 Agent loop 中，decoding policy 同时作用于自然语言、tool name、JSON key 和参数 value。自然语言 brainstorming 需要探索多个高概率路径；工具协议通常希望稳定、低熵。若整次 response 只能共享一套 sampling 参数，runtime 必须在多样性与协议可靠性间折中。更好的系统会利用结构化输出边界、候选生成后验证，或把“提出方案”和“执行动作”分成不同调用。
html.en:
Part 1 explained how cross-entropy trains pθ(next token | prefix). Part 2 explained how optimization, data, and compute shape parameters θ. Today we hold θ fixed and study inference policy. Once the model has emitted logits, the training objective is no longer active. Temperature and top-p do not update parameters during the request; they change the distribution used to select the next token.

Inside an agent loop, that policy applies to prose, tool names, JSON keys, and argument values alike. Brainstorming in natural language benefits from exploring several high-probability paths, while a tool protocol usually benefits from low entropy and stability. If an entire response must share one sampling configuration, the runtime trades diversity against protocol reliability. Better systems exploit structured-output boundaries, generate candidates and verify them, or separate “propose alternatives” from “execute an action” into different calls.

title.zh: 机制：五种控制不是一回事
title.en: Mechanism: five controls with different jobs

html.zh:
1. Greedy decoding

每步选择最大 logit 的 token。它便宜、低变异，适合格式稳定的路径，但只做局部最优；早期一个略高的 token 会永久改变后续 prefix。greedy 不等于寻找整段序列概率最高的答案，也不保证事实或工具语义正确。

2. Temperature

softmax 前把 logits 除以 T。T<1 放大差距，使分布更尖；T>1 压平差距，提升尾部概率。temperature 不改变 token 排名（有限正数 T 下），只改变相对概率。所谓 temperature 0 通常由实现特殊处理为 greedy，而不是数学上真的除以零。

3. Top-k

只保留 logit 最高的固定 k 个 token，再重新归一化。它能砍掉长尾，但固定集合大小不适应分布形状：在模型很确定时仍保留多余候选，在模型很不确定时又可能只留过少选择。

4. Top-p / nucleus sampling

按概率从高到低排序，保留累计概率首次达到阈值 p 的最小集合，再归一化采样。模型确定时 nucleus 小，不确定时自动扩大。Holtzman 等报告它在开放式文本生成中避免 unreliable tail，同时比当时的 beam search 更接近人类文本；这是指定模型与任务上的作者结果，不能直接推出 tool calling 最优。

5. Constrained decoding

grammar、JSON Schema 或有限状态机根据当前 prefix 计算合法 next tokens，把非法 logits 设为负无穷。采样只在剩余集合中进行。约束器必须处理 tokenizer 边界：一个 token 可能包含多个字符，字符串 escaping、数字范围和递归 schema 都会影响状态。若 grammar 与 tokenizer 组合后没有合法 token，decoder 会失败而不是“理解意图”。

logits = model(prefix)
logits = apply_penalties(logits, history)
logits = grammar_mask(logits, grammar_state)
logits = logits / temperature
logits = truncate_top_k_or_top_p(logits)
token = argmax(logits) if greedy else categorical(softmax(logits), rng)
prefix.append(token)

Seed 与 random-number state

seed 初始化伪随机数生成器；只有当 logits、候选集合、processor 顺序、RNG algorithm/state 和采样调用次数完全一致时，才有机会复现 token 序列。一次额外 retry、并行候选或 speculative decoding 都可能消耗不同随机数。seed 是实验控制变量，不是跨版本 API 合约。
html.en:
1. Greedy decoding

At every step, choose the token with the largest logit. Greedy decoding is cheap and low-variance, which helps stable formatting, but it is only locally optimal. One slightly higher early token permanently changes the later prefix. Greedy selection does not search for the globally highest-probability complete sequence, nor does it guarantee factual or tool-semantic correctness.

2. Temperature

Before softmax, divide logits by T. With T<1, differences grow and the distribution sharpens. With T>1, differences shrink and tail probabilities rise. For any finite positive T, temperature does not change token ranking; it changes relative probabilities. “Temperature zero” is commonly special-cased by implementations as greedy behavior rather than literally dividing by zero.

3. Top-k

Keep the k highest-logit tokens and renormalize. This removes a long tail, but a fixed candidate count does not adapt to distribution shape. When the model is confident, top-k can retain unnecessary choices; when it is uncertain, the same k may retain too few.

4. Top-p or nucleus sampling

Sort tokens by probability, retain the smallest set whose cumulative mass reaches threshold p, then renormalize and sample. The nucleus is small when the model is confident and grows when it is uncertain. Holtzman and colleagues report that nucleus sampling avoids an unreliable tail in open-ended text and produces text closer to human writing than the beam-search baselines they studied. This is an author-reported result on specific models and tasks, not evidence that nucleus sampling is optimal for tool calling.

5. Constrained decoding

A grammar, JSON Schema, or finite-state machine computes legal next tokens for the current prefix and assigns negative infinity to illegal logits. Sampling proceeds only inside the remaining set. The constraint engine must operate across tokenizer boundaries: one token may contain several characters, while escaping, number formats, and recursive schemas alter grammar state. If the grammar-tokenizer combination leaves no legal token, decoding fails; the system does not recover semantic intent by itself.

logits = model(prefix)
logits = apply_penalties(logits, history)
logits = grammar_mask(logits, grammar_state)
logits = logits / temperature
logits = truncate_top_k_or_top_p(logits)
token = argmax(logits) if greedy else categorical(softmax(logits), rng)
prefix.append(token)

Seeds and random-number state

A seed initializes a pseudorandom generator. Reproducing a token sequence requires identical logits, candidate sets, processor order, RNG algorithm and state, and the same number of random draws. One extra retry, parallel candidate, or speculative-decoding path can consume random numbers differently. A seed is an experimental control variable, not a cross-version API contract.

title.zh: 必要数学：重塑与截断分布
title.en: Essential math: reshaping and truncating a distribution

html.zh:
Temperature softmax

pᵢ(T) = exp(zᵢ/T) / Σⱼ exp(zⱼ/T)

zᵢ 是 token i 的 logit，T>0 是 temperature。对两个 token，odds ratio 为 pᵢ/pⱼ=exp((zᵢ−zⱼ)/T)：如果 logit 差为 2，T=1 时 odds 约 7.4；T=0.5 时约 54.6；T=2 时约 2.7。这说明 temperature 能显著改变多个 plausible alternatives 之间的竞争，却不会修复最高分 token 的业务错误；具体敏感度还取决于完整分布与采用的度量。

Top-p 集合

Vₚ = smallest V′ such that Σi∈V′ pᵢ ≥ p

候选按概率降序排列，Vₚ 是累计质量达到阈值的最小前缀集合。随后定义 qᵢ=pᵢ/Σj∈Vₚpⱼ（若 i∈Vₚ，否则 0）。同一个 p=0.9 可能保留 2 个或 2,000 个 token，取决于模型不确定性。top-p 控制 probability mass，不直接控制输出质量或候选数量。

Sequence probability 与局部选择

log P(x₁:T) = Σt=1T log p(xₜ | x<t)

greedy 每步最大化一项，却可能错过总和更大的另一条路径，因为选择会改变后续条件分布。beam search 保留多个累计高分 prefix，但在开放式生成中可能偏向通用、重复文本；长度 normalization 等又引入额外 policy。对 Agent 来说，sequence likelihood 也不是 task utility：一个概率更高的礼貌解释可能不如一个低概率但正确的 tool call。

约束后的条件分布

q(i | prefix, G) = p(i | prefix)·1[i∈A(G,prefix)] / Z

G 是 grammar，A 是当前合法 token 集合，indicator 对非法 token 为 0，Z 重新归一化。它严格保证语法前提，但如果合法集合包含错误 enum、危险路径或虚构 ID，约束仍会采样它。语法正确率可达到 100%，语义正确率仍需 verifier 测量。
html.en:
Temperature softmax

pᵢ(T) = exp(zᵢ/T) / Σⱼ exp(zⱼ/T)

zᵢ is the logit for token i, and T>0 is temperature. For two tokens, the odds ratio is pᵢ/pⱼ=exp((zᵢ−zⱼ)/T). If the logit difference is two, odds are about 7.4 at T=1, 54.6 at T=0.5, and 2.7 at T=2. Temperature can therefore materially change competition among plausible alternatives, while it cannot repair a business error in the highest-scored token; exact sensitivity depends on the complete distribution and the metric used.

The top-p set

Vₚ = smallest V′ such that Σi∈V′ pᵢ ≥ p

Tokens are ordered by probability, and Vₚ is the shortest prefix whose cumulative mass reaches the threshold. Define qᵢ=pᵢ/Σj∈Vₚpⱼ for tokens inside the nucleus and zero otherwise. The same p=0.9 may retain two tokens or two thousand, depending on model uncertainty. Top-p controls retained probability mass, not output quality or candidate count directly.

Sequence probability and local decisions

log P(x₁:T) = Σt=1T log p(xₜ | x<t)

Greedy decoding maximizes each term locally but can miss a path with a larger total because one choice changes every later conditional distribution. Beam search retains several high-scoring prefixes, but in open-ended generation it can favor generic or repetitive text; length normalization introduces further policy. For an agent, sequence likelihood is not task utility either: a high-probability polite explanation may be less useful than a lower-probability correct tool call.

The distribution after constraints

q(i | prefix, G) = p(i | prefix)·1[i∈A(G,prefix)] / Z

G is a grammar, A is the currently legal token set, the indicator is zero for illegal tokens, and Z renormalizes. This can strictly guarantee syntax under its assumptions. If the legal set contains an incorrect enum, dangerous path, or fabricated identifier, the constrained decoder can still select it. Syntactic validity may reach 100 percent while semantic validity still requires a verifier.

title.zh: 对 Agent 系统的影响

html.zh:
1. 按决策类型配置，而非全局一个 temperature

创意候选生成可用更高 entropy，再由 rubric/verifier 排序；tool selection、参数填充和最终副作用应使用低 entropy、schema constraint 与 policy validation。若 provider 只允许 response 级配置，可拆成 planner 与 executor 调用。

2. 多样性应在可回滚区域发生

随机探索适合生成搜索词、测试假设或计划草案；不适合直接选择转账对象、删除路径或生产发布。把 sampling 放在无副作用阶段，之后用确定性检查、审批和幂等执行收敛。

3. 记录完整 decoding provenance

trace 至少保存 model/version、prompt hash、temperature、top-k/top-p、penalties、constraint schema/version、seed（若有）与候选数。只保存 final text 无法解释回归。若 service 不承诺完全复现，仍可用这些字段缩小差异来源。

4. 测量分布，不只测一次

随机策略的单次 pass/fail 方差很大。对关键 eval 使用多个 seeds，报告 pass@1、pass@k、方差、unsafe-any-of-k 和 verifier acceptance。增加候选数通常提高“至少一个正确”的机会，也提高至少一个危险输出出现的机会，并线性或超线性增加验证成本。

5. 区分模型不确定性与采样噪声

同一 prompt 多次输出不同，可能是分布本就平坦，也可能只是 sampling policy 较宽；同一答案反复出现，也可能是模型错误地高度自信。若 API 支持 logprobs，可观察关键 token 的 margin/entropy；否则用多次采样与 prompt perturbation 估计稳定性。不要把“输出一致”直接解释成“模型确定且正确”，也不要把变化全部归因于模型知识不足。

6. Structured output 后仍要业务校验

JSON Schema 可以保证字段与类型，却不知道 customerId 是否存在、金额是否越权、工具是否幂等。parse success、schema validity、semantic validity、authorization 和 environment success 应作为五层独立指标。

7. 系统级确定性是端到端属性

即使 token 序列固定，tool API 的时间、搜索索引、数据库状态、排序 tie、重试和并发竞态仍可改变结果。若业务要求 reproducibility，需要 snapshot inputs、版本化工具与数据、确定性状态机、事件日志和 replay，而不是只把 temperature 改成 0。
html.en:
1. Configure by decision type, not one global temperature

Creative candidate generation can use higher entropy followed by rubric or verifier ranking. Tool selection, argument filling, and final side effects benefit from low entropy, schema constraints, and policy validation. If a provider exposes only response-level settings, split planning and execution into separate calls.

2. Put diversity in reversible regions

Random exploration is useful for proposing search queries, hypotheses, or draft plans. It should not directly choose a transfer recipient, deletion path, or production release. Sample before side effects, then converge through deterministic checks, approval, and idempotent execution.

3. Record complete decoding provenance

A trace should preserve model and version, prompt hash, temperature, top-k or top-p, penalties, constraint schema and version, seed when available, and candidate count. Final text alone cannot explain a regression. Even when a service does not promise exact replay, these fields narrow the source of divergence.

4. Measure a distribution, not one run

One pass or failure from a stochastic policy has high variance. For critical evaluations, run multiple seeds and report pass@1, pass@k, variance, unsafe-any-of-k, and verifier acceptance. More candidates often increase the chance that at least one is correct, but also increase the chance that at least one is unsafe and raise verification cost linearly or worse.

5. Separate model uncertainty from sampling noise

Different outputs across repeated runs may reflect a genuinely flat model distribution or simply a broad sampling policy. Repeatedly identical output may reflect confident error. When an API exposes log probabilities, inspect margins or entropy at critical tokens; otherwise estimate stability with repeated samples and prompt perturbations. Do not interpret consistency as correctness, and do not attribute every variation to missing model knowledge.

6. Validate business semantics after structured output

A JSON Schema can guarantee fields and types, but it does not know whether a customer ID exists, an amount exceeds authorization, or a tool is idempotent. Parse success, schema validity, semantic validity, authorization, and environmental success should be five separate metrics.

7. System-level determinism is end-to-end

Even with an identical token sequence, tool time, search indexes, database state, ordering ties, retries, and concurrency races can change the outcome. A reproducible business workflow needs snapshotted inputs, versioned tools and data, a deterministic state machine, event logs, and replay—not merely temperature zero.

html.zh:
低 temperature vs 错误自信：尖锐分布减少变异，也会稳定复现最高分错误。对知识缺口，降低 temperature 不是 factuality 修复；需要 retrieval、abstention 或 verifier。

高 temperature vs 长尾污染：增加多样性同时放大低概率 token，长序列中一次异常选择会重塑后续分布。top-p 可移除 tail，但阈值过低会切掉必要的罕见标识符。

Top-k vs top-p：top-k 的计算与候选数直观，top-p 适应分布熵。二者同时启用时通常取交集，processor 顺序与最小保留数会改变行为；不要把参数名当成跨实现完全相同的语义。

约束强度 vs 可达性：严格 grammar 提高 parse rate，却可能因 schema 错误让正确答案不可生成；复杂 schema 还带来状态管理和 latency。保留清晰 failure signal，不要静默退化到 unconstrained text。

复现 vs 吞吐：固定 kernel、batching 和执行顺序有助 reproducibility，却可能牺牲 continuous batching 与硬件效率。产品需明确目标是 statistical repeatability、token-exact replay，还是 environment-exact outcome；三者成本不同。

多候选 vs selection bias：best-of-N 只有在 scorer 与真实目标对齐时才有效。奖励模型或 heuristic 可被 exploit，选出的答案可能更会讨好 scorer，而不是更正确。必须用 held-out outcome 验证 selector。
html.en:
Low temperature versus confident error: a sharper distribution reduces variation while reproducing the highest-scored mistake more consistently. Lower temperature is not a factuality repair for a knowledge gap; use retrieval, abstention, or verification.

High temperature versus tail contamination: diversity rises together with the probability of unlikely tokens. In a long sequence, one unusual choice reshapes all later distributions. Top-p removes a tail, but an overly low threshold can eliminate a necessary rare identifier.

Top-k versus top-p: top-k offers an intuitive fixed candidate count; top-p adapts to entropy. When both are enabled, implementations typically intersect their retained sets, while processor order and minimum-token rules alter behavior. Do not assume identical parameter names have perfectly identical semantics across implementations.

Constraint strength versus reachability: a strict grammar raises parse rate but an incorrect schema can make the correct answer impossible to generate. Complex schemas add state-management and latency cost. Preserve an explicit failure signal rather than silently falling back to unconstrained text.

Reproducibility versus throughput: fixed kernels, batches, and execution ordering can improve replay while sacrificing continuous batching and hardware efficiency. A product must distinguish statistical repeatability, token-exact replay, and environment-exact outcomes; each has a different cost.

Multiple candidates versus selection bias: best-of-N helps only when the scorer aligns with the real objective. A reward model or heuristic can be exploited, selecting answers that please the scorer rather than answers that are correct. Validate the selector against held-out outcomes.

html.zh:
• logits 经 decoding policy 才变成 token；temperature 重塑概率，top-k/top-p 截断候选，职责不同。
  • greedy 只做逐步局部最优；temperature 0 通常是实现特例，也不提供系统级确定性。
  • constrained decoding 保证语法语言成员资格，不保证业务语义、权限或环境成功。
  • 多样性应发生在可回滚的 proposal 阶段；执行前用 verifier、policy gate 与幂等机制收敛。
  • 随机 Agent eval 要跨 seeds 报告分布；完整 provenance 是定位模型回归与 serving drift 的前提。
html.en:
• Logits become tokens only through a decoding policy. Temperature reshapes probabilities; top-k and top-p truncate candidates. They perform different jobs.
  • Greedy decoding is locally optimal one step at a time. Temperature zero is usually an implementation special case and does not provide system-level determinism.
  • Constrained decoding guarantees membership in a syntactic language, not business semantics, authorization, or environmental success.
  • Diversity belongs in a reversible proposal stage. Verifiers, policy gates, and idempotency should converge before execution.
  • Stochastic agent evaluations require distributions across seeds. Complete provenance is necessary to diagnose model regressions and serving drift.

html.zh:
• Holtzman et al., The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration — 提出 nucleus sampling，并在开放式文本上比较 sampling 与 beam/search degeneration；结论受论文模型与任务边界限制。
  • Fan et al., Hierarchical Neural Story Generation — 在故事生成中使用 top-k sampling；不是 tool-use 最优性证据。
  • Meister et al., Locally Typical Sampling — 从信息论角度提出 typical sampling，并比较多种 decoding 策略，说明“截断分布”仍是活跃设计空间。
  • Willard & Louf, Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models — 讨论用有限状态机与 token indexing 加速 grammar-guided generation。
  • Beurer-Kellner et al., Guiding LLMs The Right Way — 分析 constrained decoding 的 token misalignment 与实现正确性，提醒字符 grammar 与 subword token 间需要严谨映射。
  • PyTorch torch.multinomial documentation — 官方 categorical sampling API 的 replacement、generator 与输入权重契约；具体服务端实现未必使用 PyTorch 或相同 RNG。
  • PyTorch Reproducibility note — 官方说明跨 release、platform 或 CPU/GPU 不保证完全复现，并列出 RNG 与 deterministic algorithm 的控制边界；其他 serving stack 需查其自身契约。

本文关于 planner/executor 拆分、五层结构化输出指标和系统级 replay 的建议是基于机制的编辑性工程推论，不是上述论文共同验证的单一 Agent 架构。
html.en:
• Holtzman et al., The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration — introduces nucleus sampling and compares sampling with beam and search degeneration in open-ended text. Conclusions are bounded to the paper’s models and tasks.
  • Fan et al., Hierarchical Neural Story Generation — uses top-k sampling for story generation; it is not evidence of optimality for tool use.
  • Meister et al., Locally Typical Sampling — proposes typical sampling from an information-theoretic perspective and compares decoding strategies, illustrating that distribution truncation remains an active design space.
  • Willard & Louf, Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models — discusses finite-state machines and token indexing for efficient grammar-guided generation.
  • Beurer-Kellner et al., Guiding LLMs The Right Way — analyzes token misalignment and implementation correctness in constrained decoding, emphasizing the mapping between character grammars and subword tokens.
  • PyTorch torch.multinomial documentation — the official contract for a categorical sampling API, including replacement, generator, and input-weight behavior. A serving provider may not use PyTorch or the same RNG.
  • PyTorch Reproducibility note — officially states that complete reproducibility is not guaranteed across releases, platforms, or CPU and GPU, and describes RNG and deterministic-algorithm controls. Other serving stacks require their own contracts.

The recommendations about planner/executor separation, five-layer structured-output metrics, and system-level replay are editorial engineering deductions from the mechanisms, not one agent architecture jointly validated by the cited sources.

title.en: What is established and where we continue

html.zh:
今天已建立：decoding 是参数冻结后的 runtime policy；temperature、top-k/top-p、greedy、seed 和 grammar 分别重塑、截断、选择或限制分布。低随机性不等于正确，语法约束不等于语义验证，token 重现不等于环境结果重现。

尚未讲完：base model 学会预测、optimizer 塑造能力、sampling 选择路径之后，SFT、reward model、RLHF 与 DPO 怎样把“像互联网文本”调整成“遵循用户意图”？这些目标又会引入哪些 reward hacking、sycophancy 与 capability trade-off？

下一篇起点：训练目标与推理控制 4/4 将完成本系列：拆开 pretraining、SFT、preference data、reward modeling、PPO/RLHF 与 DPO，最后把训练目标、sampling policy 和 Agent runtime policy 串成一张完整控制栈。
html.en:
Established today: decoding is a runtime policy applied after parameters are frozen. Temperature, top-k or top-p, greedy selection, seeds, and grammars reshape, truncate, select from, or constrain the distribution in different ways. Low randomness is not correctness, syntactic constraint is not semantic verification, and token replay is not environmental replay.

Still unresolved: after a base model learns prediction, optimization shapes capability, and sampling chooses a path, how do SFT, reward models, RLHF, and DPO turn “text like the internet” into “follow the user’s intent”? What reward hacking, sycophancy, and capability trade-offs do those objectives introduce?

Next starting point: Training Objectives & Inference Control 4/4 will complete the series by separating pretraining, SFT, preference data, reward modeling, PPO/RLHF, and DPO, then unifying training objectives, sampling policy, and agent runtime policy into one control stack.

zh: temperature 重塑概率差异，top-k/top-p 截断候选集合，greedy 或 RNG 执行选择
constrained decoding 保证语法而非业务语义、授权或环境成功
seed 只有在完整 logits、processor、RNG state 与调用序列一致时才可能复现 token
系统级确定性需要版本化输入、工具、状态机与事件 replay，而不只是 temperature 0
en: Temperature reshapes probability differences, top-k or top-p truncates candidates, and greedy selection or an RNG chooses a token
Constrained decoding guarantees syntax rather than business semantics, authorization, or environmental success
A seed can reproduce tokens only when logits, processors, RNG state, and the sequence of draws are identical
System-level determinism requires versioned inputs, tools, state machines, and event replay—not merely temperature zero

next.zh: 完成本系列：SFT、reward model、PPO/RLHF 与 DPO 如何改变模型行为，以及训练目标、sampling policy 和 Agent runtime policy 的完整控制栈。
next.en: Complete the series: how SFT, reward models, PPO/RLHF, and DPO change behavior, and the full control stack spanning training objectives, sampling policy, and agent runtime policy.
